start.description: scalar or array. Specifies the starting values.

stop.description: scalar or array. Specifies the stop values.

num.description: int, optional, default=50. Number of values to generate.

endpoint.description: bool, optional, default=True. If True, then include the ``stop`` value in the result. If False, then exclude the ``stop`` value. dtype: optional. Specifies the dtype of the output.

axis.description: int, optional, default=0. Axis along which to generate the geomspace.

output.description: An array containing the geometrically-spaced values.
